approval.created_by: only a separate, user-approved one-shot Batch
required_fields: acknowledged_not_holdout_eligible (required true when the candidate is not holdout-eligible by the frozen rule)

data_requirements.checks: official checksums, immutable raw (separate holdout raw root), strict 4h validation (continuity, interval, units, symbol, source, synthetic), contiguity with the view end
data_requirements.data_not_verified: if the 2026 data fails verification AFTER values were read, the single result is HOLDOUT_DATA_NOT_VERIFIED and the attempt stays consumed
data_requirements.partial_year: forbidden: any missing monthly archive or missing/short bar prevents (or, after values were read, invalidates) the evaluation

evaluation_design.benchmark: aligned passive (entry open(start+1)), cost-free, fully invested
evaluation_design.evaluation_block: the COMPLETE year 2026-01-01T00:00 .. 2026-12-31T20:00 as ONE out-of-sample block; parameters are not changed inside 2026; earlier bars are warm-up history only
evaluation_design.final_selection_window: the last 4380 bars of the continuous research view (ending 2025-12-31T20:00)
evaluation_design.language: holdout evidence (one-shot); no proof of alpha, robustness or profitability is claimed; statistical power UNKNOWN
evaluation_design.min_folds_override: 1, only because a single holdout block cannot contain 3 folds; no other threshold is changed
evaluation_design.selection: every grid configuration x S1/S2/S3 on that window; rank by the WORST train score across S1/S2/S3; ties -> grid order
evaluation_design.status_rule: frozen thresholds via classify_candidate(min_folds=1): the single 2026 block is one fold; closed trades >= 30, active fold, profitable after costs, positive-fold majority (1/1); candidate status = least favourable of S1/S2/S3; 'holdout_eligible_like' additionally needs beating the aligned passive benchmark in every scenario
evaluation_design.unit: the whole frozen selection procedure for the selected strategy, evaluated exactly once

exactly_once.attempt_file: created exclusively before any value is read, never removed

known_risk_disclosed_before_evaluation.note: a one-year block at the development trade rate gives fewer than the frozen 30 closed trades, so INSUFFICIENT_ACTIVITY is a likely outcome of the frozen heuristic (counts only; UNKNOWN)

nature: PRE-EVALUATION immutable addendum: written before any 2026 value is read; the frozen Protocol v2 hash is not modified
